parts.note: types /compact into other sessions; needs ORCH_AUTOCOMPACT=1 and a non-empty WATCH_ONLY

needs: screen text: prompt arrow, Esc to cancel, Do you want

HC_SELF.note: this window's address (falls back to HC_TERMINAL_ID); required

WATCH_ONLY.note: allow list: only windows whose label starts with this text are watched

CTX_PCT.note: compact threshold in percent, never below 57

CTRL_PCT.note: threshold for control-tower windows and this controller, never below 65

COMPACT_COOLDOWN_MS.note: minimum gap between two compacts of one window

ORCH_CTRL_MATCH.note: name fragment that marks control-tower windows (CTRL_MATCH still works)
